selection: mean Macro-F1 across three tasks, equal weights, eligible CLIP-IndoBERT shared neural MTL family
backbone: CLIP ViT-L14 frozen full/crop + IndoBERT first10 frozen, last2 fine-tuned
head: shared256 ReLU dropout0.3 then three heads
loss: class-weighted CE with fixed per-task weights; six original LR/loss configurations selected inner-only
validity: internal adaptive repeated-corpus CV; not independent external acceptance
